title: Planetary faunal lineage roster
scope: Seven-lineage planetary faunal body-plan roster at silhouette-and-niche-theme level, with independently evolved flight in more than one lineage. Lineage names, in-world taxonomy, anatomy, reproduction, physiology, Mana patterns, local presence, minor lineages, and sapient-people assignments remain open.
approval_evidence: After the A/B/C roster options were presented with A recommended, the Author replied 'A', adding a follow-up flora-coverage question routed to a separate floral-roster proposal, on 2026-08-17.
question: How many major animal body-plan lineages should anchor the planet's macroscopic faunal diversity, and where should winged forms come from?
selection: Adopt the seven-lineage Convergent-skies roster: I six-limbed filament-and-scute animals with possible wing-pair branches (four-legged winged forms); II tower-necked four-limbed landscape engineers; III low-frame four-limbed generalists with possible forelimb-winged branches; IV fully aquatic flexible-trunk fin-fan animals anchored by the mass breeder; V tri-radial hydrostatic animals anchored by the family-care migrant; VI small-bodied segmented exoskeletal animals including small-scale flyers; VII unsegmented soft-bodied animals. Flight arose independently in more than one lineage, and every lineage includes abundant ordinary forms.
alternatives: FAUNA-ROSTER-A: seven lineages with convergently evolved flight; selected.
FAUNA-ROSTER-B: eight lineages with one dedicated ancestrally winged lineage owning macro-scale flight; not selected.
FAUNA-ROSTER-C: retain five slots and define III-V only, leaving the tri-radial migrant and small-bodied life outside the framework; not selected.
rationale: The selected roster covers every silhouette class the Author requested (familiar four-limbed, six-limbed, winged-plus-four-limbed, and further alien classes), gives both provisionally accepted lake migrants lineage homes, supplies the ordinary-organism backbone the ecological direction demands, and mirrors Earth's repeated independent evolution of flight so mythic and familiar flyer silhouettes coexist without one lineage monopolising the air.
consequences: The planet's macroscopic animal life is organised across seven major body-plan lineages.
Lineage II and both lake migrants retain their existing bounded records and gain roster slots.
Winged four-legged forms are a Lineage I possibility; two-winged two-legged forms are a Lineage III possibility; small-scale flight is a Lineage VI possibility.
Lineages VI and VII anchor small-bodied ordinary life for later decomposer, pollinator-analogue, parasite, and swarm-prey design.
Later per-lineage and per-species development must proceed through bounded proposals against these slots.
No System mechanic, creature progression rule, spawn source, or Earth transplant is created.
residual_unknowns: Final lineage names and all in-world taxonomies remain open.
Per-lineage anatomy, covering microstructure, reproduction, senses, cognition, and Mana patterns remain open except where existing records govern.
Deep ancestry, divergence order, relatedness among lineages, and extinct sibling lineages remain open.
Which lineage holds the WLD-ECOLOGY-006 bird-like fishing organisms and other referenced-but-unassigned fauna remains open.
Minor or relict lineages below the framework's grain remain possible through their own records.
No sapient people is assigned to any lineage.
Whether flora needs a parallel producer-kingdom roster is routed to a separate proposal.
reopening_conditions: A needed body plan cannot plausibly fit any roster slot.
Lineage-first design proves too coarse or too restrictive for story needs.
A concrete contradiction with an accepted or provisional record emerges.
The Author explicitly reopens the decision.
